query:
SELECT DISTINCT t COLLATE "C" AS "tag!"
              FROM run r
              JOIN item i ON i.id = r.item_id
              JOIN box b ON b.id = r.target_box_id
             CROSS JOIN UNNEST(i.required_tags) t
             WHERE r.id = $1
               AND t <> ALL (b.probed_tags || b.declared_tags)
             ORDER BY 1
